about.hero_desc: Professional advice on electricity, gas and internet
about.phil_p1: As an independent consultancy firm, we are not tied to specific providers. This independence is the core of our business model and allows us to act entirely in your interest.
about.phil_p2: Our goal is to make the complex energy and telecommunications market transparent for you. We analyze your current contracts, uncover savings potential, and develop customized solutions that perfectly match your consumption patterns.
about.phil_p3: Through our extensive network and continuous market monitoring, we secure conditions that are often not publicly available.
about.exp_p1: For over seven years, we have been helping companies and individuals find the best solutions for electricity, gas, and internet.
about.exp_p2: Under the leadership of Shoaib Alemi, our team provides personal, transparent, and reliable advice on a wide range of tariff options. We help businesses and private customers make informed decisions that truly fit their needs.
about.exp_p3: With deep experience in energy and telecommunications contracts, we explain complex options in a simple and clear way – so you can save costs, reduce risks, and plan with confidence.
about.exp_p4: Many companies prefer personal consultation over online comparisons. That's why we welcome you at our store in the heart of Aachen or online – whatever is most convenient for you.
about.exp_quote: Our goal is simple: reliable service, maximum planning security, and the best solution for you.
about.exp_f1_desc: We work independently and recommend what's best for you.
about.exp_f2_desc: We compare tariffs clearly so you can make informed decisions.
about.exp_f3_desc: We take the time to understand your requirements and goals.
about.exp_f4_desc: We're here for you – before, during, and after your decision.
about.cta_desc: We're happy to help you with customized solutions for your electricity, gas, and internet contracts.

elec.hero_desc: We compare electricity tariffs and help you reduce your energy costs – in person in Aachen or conveniently online.

elec.f2_d: We will explain contract durations, price guarantees and other important tariff details in a way that is easy to understand.

elec.tl_t1: In 4 simple steps to the right
elec.tl_desc: We make the entire process transparent, simple and efficient so you can focus on what really matters: your business.
elec.s1_d: The first step to finding the right electricity tariff is a personal consultation. You can visit us anytime at our shop in the center of Aachen or contact us online.
elec.s2_d: Based on the information you provide, we compare a wide range of electricity tariffs from various providers. We pay close attention to important factors such as price and contract duration.
elec.s3_d: After presenting you with various tariff options, you can take your time to decide which electricity tariff best suits your business.
elec.s4_d: Once you've chosen a new electricity tariff, we'll support you throughout the entire switching process without any interruption to your power supply.
elec.q1: Is switching electricity tariffs complicated for businesses?
elec.a1: No. The new provider usually handles the organizational steps for the switch.
elec.q2: Will there be an interruption in the electricity supply?
elec.a2: No. Your power supply remains secure at all times. There is no risk of blackout.
elec.q3: How long does it take to switch providers?
elec.a3: The switch usually takes place within a few weeks and is implemented automatically by the new provider.

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked
faq_page.a1: Yes, our tariff consultation is 100% free and non-binding. We compare electricity, gas, and internet tariffs for you – with no hidden costs.
faq_page.q2: How long does switching providers take?
faq_page.a2: We handle the entire process for you. Switching usually takes 2–4 weeks, and you don't have to worry about anything.
faq_page.a3: Yes, we advise both private customers and businesses in Aachen and the surrounding area – in person, independently, and free of charge.
faq_page.q4: Do I have to cancel my current contract?
faq_page.a4: No. As soon as you decide on a new tariff, we take care of canceling your old contract and managing the entire switching process for you.
faq_page.q5: Which regions do you operate in?
faq_page.a5: Our main location is Aachen, Alexianergraben 9. However, we also advise customers throughout Germany – in person on site or by phone.
